states.unavailable: not found in archived sources; reason required
states.not_required_by_cited_rule: only when a cited rule (document + article) exempts this entity/period; never inferred
states.withheld: value exists but is held by a quality gate (e.g. lineage, display acceptance)
states.comparison_excluded: value may be shown for the entity but excluded from peer comparison (e.g. bank FCF)

global_rules: Never convert a missing field to not_applicable without a cited rule (document, article, version).
Entity type is taken from an official document (fund terms and conditions / commercial registration / Saudi Exchange profile), not from the name.
Company keys are not reused for funds; fund keys are not reused for companies.
Every value states its period and scope; source presence is not independent verification.

reit.applies_to: Listed real-estate investment traded funds (e.g. candidate 4340 Al Rajhi REIT — entity type still unverified)
reit.unit_of_ownership: units (not shares); per-unit figures use 'per unit' labels

fields.source_document: Annual report / audited FS related-party note

sections.rule: Company governance keys must not be filled for a fund; fund board and manager fields replace them.

fields.source_document: Calculated only from accepted NAV per unit + same-date market price; never mixed dates

fields.field: properties: name, city, type, ownership form

sections.rule_source_required: Any statutory minimum distribution must be cited from the CMA instructions for real-estate investment traded funds (article and version) before it is displayed or used for a gap verdict.

fields.source_document: Fund terms and conditions / annual report

sections.rule_source_required: Any regulatory leverage limit must be cited (CMA instructions) before display.

fields.field: fund financial statements (IFRS as endorsed in KSA)
funds_from_operations only if the fund discloses it

sections.rule: Corporate ratios (e.g. EPS, capex/CFO, FCF) are not computed for funds unless an approved fund formula exists; until then: withheld, not 'not applicable'.

topic_map.competitors: peer REITs only as inferred peers, never 'competitors' unless the fund names them
topic_map.guidance: fund manager statements in the annual report only
topic_map.sustainability: only if the fund reports it

nomu_company.applies_to: Companies listed on the Saudi Exchange parallel market (Nomu) (e.g. candidate 9510 — unverified)
nomu_company.inherits: ordinary company profile for the company's sector

rules.text: Show 'Parallel Market (Nomu)' on every page section that compares with main-market companies.

rules.rule_source_required: Periodic reporting obligations (annual / interim frequency and deadlines) must be cited from the CMA Rules on the Offer of Securities and Continuing Obligations (article, version, effective date) applicable to Nomu issuers.
rules.until_cited: A missing quarter is 'unavailable' (reason: rule not yet cited), never 'not applicable' and never a quality defect.

rules.text: Every figure states its period type (annual / semi-annual / quarterly) from the filing itself; no annualisation of a half-year.
Peer comparison with main-market companies only for same-period, same-scope figures; otherwise comparison_excluded.

rules.rule_source_required: Any statement about who may trade Nomu shares must be cited from current CMA rules; do not state from memory.

company.scope_rule: Every figure carries the document scope (consolidated / standalone); standalone statements (e.g. 3020 Yamama) never shown as group data.

banks.corporate_metrics_policy: FCF and capex/CFO are comparison_excluded for banks (deposit/loan flows sit in operating cash flow); shown only with an explanatory note, never 'not applicable'.

insurance.corporate_metrics_policy: Corporate margins based on 'revenue' must use the IFRS 17 line names; no mapping to legacy GWP without a cited note.

real_estate_development.corporate_metrics_policy: Operating cash outflow from development spend is shown with that context; no 'cash burn' label without a cited basis.

utilities_power_water.corporate_metrics_policy: Equity-accounted project companies kept separate from consolidated figures.

kpis_if_disclosed: reserves/resources with reporting code and date
mining_metals.corporate_metrics_policy: Reserves/resources only with the reporting code and effective date stated.

telecom.corporate_metrics_policy: Issuer market-share statements labelled as issuer statements.

retail.corporate_metrics_policy: Seasonality noted when quarters are compared.

healthcare.corporate_metrics_policy: Beds/patients only as disclosed per period.
